name: Sequential Consistency
description: The strongest model. All operations appear to execute in a single global total order consistent with each thread's program order. No reordering of any kind is permitted.

irm.note: Poetzl & Kroening §4 prove inverse roach motel sound for the SC-for-DRF execution model, of which plain SC is the race-free contract.

catSupport.note: herd7 ships sc.cat; the zoo runs the portable litmus/models/abstract-sc.cat. A single acyclicity axiom over po and the communication relations.

katSupport.note: kater's kat/sc.kat: the single relation sc = po | rf | mo | fr, constrained acyclic.
